stories.headline_en: Artists mourn Dolly Parton's death

stories.summary_en: Artists express their appreciation for Dolly Parton, the country singer and cultural icon. The piece celebrates her influence across music, camp aesthetics, and philanthropy.

stories.summary_en: Oototol's artistic visions remain deliberately ambiguous, resisting political, psychological, or biographical readings. The work maintains an intentional opacity.
stories.summary_de: Oototols künstlerische Visionen bleiben bewusst mehrdeutig und widerstehen politischen, psychologischen oder biografischen Deutungen. Das Werk bewahrt absichtliche Undurchsichtigkeit.

stories.headline_en: Marcin photographs Baltimore's marginal housing
stories.summary_en: Ben Marcin's photographs document lone houses, derelict homes, and makeshift camps in Baltimore. The work offers insight into how Americans on the margins live.
stories.summary_de: Ben Marcins Fotografien dokumentieren einzelne Häuser, verfallene Gebäude und provisorische Lager in Baltimore. Die Arbeit zeigt, wie Amerikaner am Rand der Gesellschaft leben.

stories.headline_en: Finsbury Circus Parks Office opens

stories.headline_en: Pensaer's sculptural London extension

stories.headline_en: B&B Italia marks 60 years with design campaign retrospective

stories.headline_en: Museum Thefts Rise With Weapons, Europol Warns
stories.summary_en: A Europol report documents an increase in violent museum robberies involving weapons and explosives. The trend reflects growing criminal demand for jewels and cultural artifacts.

stories.headline_en: Artist Marijke De Roover Dies at 36
stories.summary_en: Queer feminist artist Marijke De Roover, celebrated for wit and humor, has died at 36. Friends have launched a crowdfunding campaign to preserve her archive.
stories.summary_de: Die queer-feministische Künstlerin Marijke De Roover ist im Alter von 36 Jahren verstorben. Freunde haben eine Crowdfunding-Kampagne zur Bewahrung ihres Archivs gestartet.

stories.headline_en: V&A to celebrate Freddie Mercury with fashion exhibition
stories.headline_de: V&A würdigt Freddie Mercury mit Mode-Ausstellung
stories.summary_en: The V&A is presenting 'Splendid Things', a free exhibition marking the 80th anniversary of Freddie Mercury's birth, opening in October. The show celebrates Mercury's fashion legacy.

stories.summary_en: Sliman Mansour, a painter known for depicting Palestinian humanity and hope, has died at 79. In a 2023 interview, he emphasized the full humanity of Palestinian people.

stories.headline_en: Wiener Werkstätte Women in Focus

stories.headline_en: Venezuelan Op art pioneers exhibited in Palm Desert
stories.headline_de: Venezolanische Op-Art-Pioniere in Palm Desert gezeigt
stories.summary_en: Heather James Fine Art presents "Completing the Illusion," an exhibition examining Venezuelan Op art pioneers. The show reexamines the achievements of the movement.

stories.summary_en: Immanuel Wilkins recorded three hours of his performance at the Village Vanguard jazz club in New York. The resulting live album is described as among the best in jazz history.

stories.summary_en: Simon Houfe, writer, art historian and journalist, has died aged 83. He edited Antique Collector (1970–74) and wrote nine books while contributing to Country Life and Apollo.

stories.summary_en: Aardman Animations co-founders Peter Lord and David Sproxton were knighted this year. The studio, which created Morph and Wallace & Gromit, became employee-owned in 2018.
